h.Não vinculamos endereço IP ao toque. Não: We do not link the IP address to the tap. We do not record any device identifier. We do not record name, phone, e-mail or any form of contact. There is no form, no registration and no app to install. The only exception, temporary and kept outside the tap record, is described in section 4.4.
h.A página intermediária pela qual o consu: The intermediate page the consumer passes through before reaching Google does not load analytics or advertising cookies. It exists solely to perform the redirect. The same applies to the Trybo card selection screen: no analytics or advertising cookies, no third-party scripts.
h.Por que existe. O número de toques é o r: Why it exists. The number of taps is the result the merchant tracks for each StarTouch device and each Trybo card — often broken down by team professional, to whom the merchant hands a card or a wristband. This creates an incentive to tap one's own phone on one's own device to increase the count. Without protection, the number would no longer be reliable for the merchant and would be unfair to those who work honestly.
h.Como funciona. No momento do toque, calc: How it works. At the moment of the tap, we calculate a code from the IP address and the information the browser sends about itself, combined with the device tapped and a secret key that changes every day and is discarded. This code serves a single question: "has this same phone already tapped this same device today?" If so, the tap is recorded as repeated and is not included in the count. The consumer is sent to Google or to the social network in exactly the same way — the protection changes the count, never the path.
h.o código não é o seu IP e não permite vo: the code is not your IP and cannot be traced back to it;
h.ele não é gravado no registro de toques: it is not stored in the tap record described in section 4.1, which remains free of any identifier;
h.ele é eliminado em até 24 horas por roti: it is deleted within 24 hours by an automatic routine, whose execution is logged;
h.como a chave muda a cada dia e a anterio: since the key changes every day and the previous one is discarded, it is not possible — not even for us — to know whether two taps on different days came from the same phone;
h.ele não é usado para nenhuma outra final: it is not used for any other purpose, is not cross-referenced with any other database and is not shared.
h.Mesmo com essas proteções, tratamos esse: Even with these protections, we treat this code as pseudonymized personal data, which is why it is declared here. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX, and Art. 10, II) — prevention of fraud in the count, for the benefit of the merchant and the team's professionals. It is the same purpose of protection against abusive use already described in section 6.3, applied with less data (a code instead of the IP address) and for less time (24 hours instead of 30 days).
h.Ao lojista, mostramos apenas quantos toq: To the merchant, we show only how many taps were considered repeated on each device — never which phone they came from, information that we ourselves do not have. The tap record in section 4.1 remains free of any identifier: a repeated tap never even reaches it.
h.Base legal: legítimo interesse (Art. 7º,: Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX), applied to data made manifestly public by the data subjects themselves when they published the review (Art. 7, § 4).

h.Para impedir uso automatizado abusivo de: To prevent abusive automated use of free features, we temporarily record the IP address of whoever makes requests, associated with a counter. The IP address is personal data and the processing is justified by the security of the service. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX).
h.Atribuímos ao navegador do visitante um: We assign the visitor's browser a random identifier, stored locally on the device itself, to measure the journey within the site in aggregate form. It is not linked to your name, e-mail or account. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX).
h.Não guardamos uma linha por pessoa. Cada: We do not keep one row per person. Each record is just a number — "on September 2, the home page was opened 37 times by people who came from Instagram". We do not store IP address, device or browser type, cookie, browsing identifier or the exact time of access. It is not possible, not even for us, to separate one visit from the others within that number, or to know whether two visits came from the same person.
h.Pelo mesmo método e com a mesma natureza: Using the same method and with the same nature, we count how many times each option in the cookie notice was chosen — how many acceptances, how many refusals and how many times the notice was shown without anyone clicking. Here too the record is just one number per day; we do not know, and have no way of knowing, what decision a specific person made. This count exists so we know what proportion of the site the analytics tools are able to measure and whether the notice needs to be improved.
